reasoning: This suite covers the consequential contract rules for reading cases, listing and creating notes, and viewing recent orders, with emphasis on note-creation boundaries, existence checks, media type, and rate limiting. It deliberately leaves out auth permutations, response body schema field-by-field assertions, pagination/sorting details, and concurrency/idempotency because those rules were not provided and would require contract specifics to test precisely.
